Transport Documents

قائمة التفريغ

A port or vessel document listing all cargo units or containers to be unloaded at a specific port of call, used for planning and operational control.

Why it matters

قائمة التفريغ matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

What is قائمة التفريغ?

In this glossary, قائمة التفريغ refers to: A port or vessel document listing all cargo units or containers to be unloaded at a specific port of call, used for planning and operational control.

How is قائمة التفريغ used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "قبل الوصول، قدّم وكيل السفينة قائمة التفريغ لمشغل الميناء لتخطيط عمليات تفريغ الحاويات."

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A port or vessel document listing all cargo units or containers to be unloaded at a specific port of call, used for planning and operational control.

Operational example

Before arrival, the vessel agent submitted the discharge list to the port operator for planning the container unload operations.

Localized term

قائمة التفريغ
